verdict.rationale: GitLab's own materials say it consolidates SAST (code security issues) and SCA (vulnerable dependencies) scanners into the platform. They also say these run in every pipeline, with findings surfaced in merge requests and IDEs, and that Trivy is the default container scanning engine. Third-party partner scanners are not credited. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on SCA/SAST configuration and language coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic scanning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have my repository automatically scanned for vulnerable dependencies and code security issues

citations.quote: Consolidate scanners like SAST, SCA, Secret Detection, and DAST into one platform.
SAST, DAST, and compliance in every pipeline.
Security findings appear directly in merge requests and IDEs.
Starting in 14.0, GitLab will begin using Trivy as its default container scanning engine
